method: Installed ajv@6.12.3 and har-schema@2.0.0 in an isolated temporary tree without a lockfile, loaded draft-06 plus all 18 schemas with allErrors true, normalized falsy inputs as upstream does, serialized success/error outcomes in har-schema key order, and hashed the ordered JSON with SHA-256. The committed differential test recomputes the same outcome hash using the maintained implementation.
